Definitions, data and limitations
  • Dropout rate: students who dropped out divided by all students in the group. "Still enrolled" stays in the denominator.
  • First-semester pass share: approved divided by enrolled first-semester units. Students who enrolled in no units are shown separately as "No units".
  • 95% range: Wilson score interval. Groups under 30 students are faded.
  • Alert builder: workload is flagged students divided by all students in view, coverage is flagged dropouts divided by all dropouts in view, and hit rate is the dropout rate among flagged students.
  • Source: UCI Machine Learning Repository, Predict Students' Dropout and Academic Success (DOI 10.24432/C5MC89); Realinho et al. (2022), Data 7(11):146. 4,424 students at one Portuguese institution, 2008/09 to 2018/19. The team decoded the numeric codes into labels, and the data had no missing cells or duplicate rows.
  • Limitations: one institution, so results may not apply elsewhere. These are associations, not causes. The data does not say when tuition status was recorded, so some students may have stopped paying because they were already leaving.
